Apply the upper-population ratio correction

Source: R/functionsForBenchmarking-Cyt.R
dot-simCytRatioAdjustUpper.Rd

The target ratio is measured on the pre-transformation scale as the distance from the upper mean to the lower reference mean, divided by the combined spread of the lower and upper populations. The achieved ratio is measured after the transformation in the same way. Only the upper population is adjusted: its mean distance is multiplied by c and its SD is multiplied by 1 / c.

Usage

.simCytRatioAdjustUpper(
  yUpper,
  xUpperRaw,
  xLowerRaw,
  yLower,
  lowerMeanRawReference,
  lowerMeanTransReference,
  eps = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)
)
